column1: Explains procedure to patient & obtain consent
Use blood form/transfusion prescription collect right blood from the laboratory
Set a tray for the procedure including blood given set
Check pre transfusion vital signs and record
Position patient, provide privacy and administer any pre – transfusion medications
Re-check blood bag profiles with blood form
Fix blood given set to blood bag, hang it and expel air
Open IV line with big size cannula, secure with adhesive plaster and connect blood set with cannula (doctor procedure)
Make patient comfortable/ provide support and discard used items
Monitor V/S 1 hourly until 4hours after transfusion

Watch out for signs of reaction during and 4hours after transfusion, e.g. restlessness, cool, shivery, raised temperature and breathing. If any, clip and stop transfusion, call for help and give prescribed hydrocortisone
